title: Unit customer carousel
description: A one-line heading with two round arrow buttons at the right, over a sideways track of pale, nearly square-cornered company cards that runs off the right edge of the window: a bold wordmark with a hairline arrow circle, a two-line description and a large rounded brand-colour tile at the foot. The arrows glide the track one card at a time and fade to half when there's nowhere to go; on phones the track is swiped.
notes: media slot per card: the brand tile (295×199, rounded); empty placeholders rotate through chart tones and the foreground
the track aligns its first card with the page content and bleeds off the right
